$comment: Conformance vectors for the `copilot.command` key on a user Message._meta. See ../user-message.md (the 'copilot.command' section) and ./README.md for the harness contract. The key holds a structured host-command marker — a closed object `{ name, focus? }`. The marker extractor returns no command for a missing/malformed marker or an unrecognized name; an empty focus collapses to none. Complete recognition orders a recognized marker before valid nonempty copilot.modelText before the free-typed Message.text match. A valid modelText prevents text-based command recognition, including when the marker is malformed or unrecognized. These vectors pin `set`, marker-only `extract`, combined-precedence `resolveCommand`, and flat-dotted `wireShape`. In `extract` and `resolveCommand`, expected.command is `{ name, focus }`, with focus null for a bare command, or JSON null when no host command is recovered.

tests.name: set: stamps the marker onto _meta, preserving other keys
tests.$comment: The marker rides the message-level `_meta`, alongside any other copilot keys already present. `set` inserts the host-owned marker value verbatim.

tests.name: extract: bare compact marker recovers a focus-less command
tests.$comment: A `{ name: compact }` marker (no focus) recovers Compact{focus: None}, projected here as focus: null.

tests.name: extract: compact marker with focus recovers the focus text
extract: empty focus collapses to a bare command
tests.$comment: An all-whitespace or empty `focus` is treated as no focus, matching the free-typed `/compact` text match.

tests.name: extract: unrecognised command name falls back to none
tests.$comment: An unknown name is not a structured host command. The caller considers modelText next, and only matches Message.text if that override is absent, empty, or wrong-type.

tests.name: extract: no marker falls back to none
tests.$comment: Without a marker there is no structured command. Complete recognition considers modelText before the free-typed text match; this marker-only operation returns null.

tests.name: resolveCommand: recognized marker wins over modelText and display text
resolveCommand: unrecognized marker and valid modelText suppress display command
resolveCommand: malformed marker and valid modelText suppress display command
resolveCommand: modelText is not reparsed as a host command
resolveCommand: whitespace modelText remains a valid nonempty override
resolveCommand: empty modelText permits case-insensitive display recognition
resolveCommand: malformed marker and wrong-type modelText permit display recognition
resolveCommand: null modelText permits display recognition
wireShape: marker object under the flat dotted key
tests.$comment: Pins the flat-dotted `copilot.command` key (not a nested `copilot` object) holding the closed marker object.
